description: A waiting edit changed: what it puts in, and what it replaces if old_text is given (found once in the page, not in another waiting edit's passage). It stays one edit, by by now; new_text the same as what it replaces takes it back. Answered with edit.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

notebook.description: The notebook: its id, or its name (any case).

old_text.description: What it replaces now; left out: as it was.

by.description: Who's proposing it, by name (Meta, an agent's own name): kept with the edit, and shown with it.
